name: sos-apollo-harm-control
description: Deterministic, offline, login-free harm-control runtime. No LLM. Registry-driven.

scripts.verify: npm run registry:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:exhaustive && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run registry:check && tsx scripts/build.ts && tsx scripts/build-demo.ts && tsx scripts/build-lab.ts
scripts.build:check: tsx scripts/build.ts --check && tsx scripts/build-demo.ts --check && tsx scripts/build-lab.ts --check
